name: @pdpp/conformance-suite
description: Role-based executable conformance suite for PDPP Core v0.1 Section 9. Black-box and adapter-driven: target cases use TargetAdapter, and client cases use ClientUnderTest against an instrumented fixture. Produces a machine-readable report that distinguishes pass/fail/skip/unsupported/not-tested against the full Section 9 requirement denominator, and confers no status of any kind.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm test
